G1.quote: Page is documented as 1-based, so page 1 should have offset 0, but this computes 1*PageSize, skipping the entire first page. Should be (p.Page-1) * p.PageSize.

G2.quote: Sort (raw from q.Get("sort")) is concatenated straight into the query with no whitelist. That's an injection point

G3.quote: Every other admin route wraps with requireAdmin(cfg.AdminToken, ...) ... This one doesn't, and deleteOrder itself never calls userID(r) or checks anything — so any unauthenticated caller can delete any order

G4.quote: Set/Delete take c.mu.Lock(), but Get reads c.entries[id] unlocked. That's a concurrent map read/write

G5.quote: countRows is never closed ... s.db.QueryContext(...) for the count leaks the *sql.Rows/connection on every call. Since you only expect one row, use QueryRowContext instead, or defer countRows.Close().

G6.quote: A real DB error is logged but swallowed — the handler still responds 204.

G7.quote: time.Duration is nanoseconds, so CacheTTLSeconds: 30 becomes a 30ns TTL, not 30s.

D2.quote: the per-goroutine loop variable capture in batchGetOrders is fine
